name: rank_currency_conversions
description: Ranks currency conversions by CZK per single foreign unit (rate/unit_amount) and returns strongest and weakest.

manifest.name: rank_currency_conversions
manifest.description: Ranks currency conversions by CZK per single foreign unit (rate/unit_amount) and returns strongest and weakest.
manifest.notes: No network used. Input items from CNB steps have currency, rate (CZK per unit_amount), unit_amount (e.g. JPY=100), czk, rate_date. Per-unit = rate/unit_amount. Duplicate currencies are collapsed (last wins). rate_date output is the latest date among inputs.

files.test_impl.py:
import pytest
from impl import run

EX = {'conversions': [
    {'amount': 1, 'currency': 'USD', 'rate': 21.811, 'unit_amount': 1.0, 'czk': 21.81, 'rate_date': '2026-10-08'},
    {'amount': 1, 'currency': 'EUR', 'rate': 24.4, 'unit_amount': 1.0, 'czk': 24.4, 'rate_date': '2026-10-08'},
    {'amount': 1, 'currency': 'GBP', 'rate': 28.807, 'unit_amount': 1.0, 'czk': 28.81, 'rate_date': '2026-10-08'},
    {'amount': 1, 'currency': 'CHF', 'rate': 26.173, 'unit_amount': 1.0, 'czk': 26.17, 'rate_date': '2026-10-08'},
    {'amount': 1, 'currency': 'JPY', 'rate': 13.784, 'unit_amount': 100.0, 'czk': 0.14, 'rate_date': '2026-10-08'}]}

def test_example():
    r = run(EX)
    assert r['strongest'] == 'GBP'
    assert r['weakest'] == 'JPY'
    assert [x['currency'] for x in r['ranking']] == ['GBP', 'CHF', 'EUR', 'USD', 'JPY']
    assert r['rate_date'] == '2026-10-08'
    assert r['ranking'][-1]['czk_per_unit'] == pytest.approx(0.13784)

def test_single():
    r = run({'conversions': [{'currency': 'usd', 'rate': 20, 'unit_amount': 1}]})
    assert r['strongest'] == r['weakest'] == 'USD'

def test_empty():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'conversions': []})

def test_bad():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'conversions': [{'currency': 'USD', 'rate': 'x'}]})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'conversions': [{'currency': 'USD', 'rate': 1, 'unit_amount': 0}]})
